info.title: corvusjson
info.description: CLI tool for generating strongly-typed C# from JSON Schema, JSONata, JMESPath, and JSON Logic. Supports both Corvus.Text.Json (V5) and Corvus.Json (V4) output. Covers JSON Schema draft 4, 6, 7, 2019-09, and 2020-12.
